entities.name: Trini Tinturé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Trini Tinturé was a Spanish cartoonist and illustrator. Her work has a prominent place in the history of 20th-century comics. She worked mainly for the foreign market. She specialized in comics aimed at girls and teenagers, among which Emma es encantadora (1981), her most representative work in Spain, created in collaboration with the scriptwriter Andreu Martín, stands out. She was honored with the Grand Prize at the 2023 Barcelona International Comic Fair.
